info.title: Meerkateer API
info.description: Tenant-isolated Meerkateer control-plane API. Browser mutations require both the session cookie and the X-Meerkateer-CSRF header.

get.description: Read whether this control plane still needs its first owner setup. No tenant data is exposed.

post.description: Send a clearly marked test message to the installation-level Community alert webhook. Requires an owner session and CSRF header.

204.description: The receiver accepted the test message.

403.description: The session is not authorized or CSRF protection failed.

409.description: No webhook is configured.

500.description: The alert transport could not be initialized.

502.description: The receiver did not accept the message.

get.description: Read the tenant alert transition policy and whether the installation webhook is configured.

put.description: Update down/recovery notification and bounded cooldown policy. Requires an owner or admin and CSRF proof.

400.description: Cooldown must be between 0 and 86400 seconds.

403.description: The role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

get.description: List durable alert outcomes for one tenant workspace, including suppression and failures.

400.description: The query is invalid.

post.description: Create a new audited delivery attempt from a dead-lettered alert while preserving the original record.

204.description: A new queued delivery was created.

403.description: The role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The delivery is absent or tenant-hidden.

409.description: The delivery is not dead-lettered or the webhook is not configured.

get.description: List durable open and resolved incidents for one tenant workspace.

400.description: The query is invalid.

get.description: List operator acknowledgement, assignment, and note activity for one workspace.

400.description: The query is invalid.

post.description: Acknowledge an incident without changing monitored health or resolving it.

204.description: Incident acknowledged, or was already acknowledged.

403.description: The role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The incident is absent or tenant-hidden.

put.description: Assign the current operator to an incident or clear its assignment.

204.description: Assignment updated, or already in the requested state.

403.description: The role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The incident is absent or tenant-hidden.

post.description: Add an immutable bounded operator note to an incident.

400.description: The note is empty or too long.

403.description: The role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The incident is absent or tenant-hidden.

200.description: Scheduled, active, completed, and cancelled windows.

post.description: Schedule service-level notification suppression for at most 90 days. Health evidence remains visible.

400.description: The bounded window is invalid.

403.description: The role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The service is not in the selected workspace.

delete.description: Cancel a non-cancelled maintenance window without deleting its audit history.

403.description: The role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The window is absent, tenant-hidden, or already cancelled.

get.description: Read the tenant append-only administrative audit stream. Requires owner or admin.

403.description: Owner or admin role is required.

get.description: Read tenant-scoped operational counts plus installation worker progress. Requires owner or admin.

403.description: Owner or admin role is required.

post.description: Create the first tenant and owner exactly once using the deployment setup key. The optional owner password enables routine email/password sign-in.

201.description: Bootstrap completed and an HttpOnly session cookie was issued.

400.description: The bounded request is invalid.

404.description: Bootstrap is disabled by configuration.

409.description: Bootstrap was already completed.

post.description: Sign in to the self-hosted Community owner account with email and password.

200.description: A Community owner session and CSRF cookie were issued.

401.description: The email or password is incorrect.

404.description: Password login is not available in this deployment mode.

409.description: Initial setup is required.

post.description: Set or recover the self-hosted owner password with the deployment setup key.

200.description: The owner password was set and a browser session was issued.

400.description: The new password is invalid.

404.description: Password setup is not available in this deployment mode.

409.description: Initial setup is required or the owner is unavailable.

put.description: Change the signed-in Community member password and revoke every other active session for that member.

204.description: Password changed; the current session remains active and all other sessions are revoked.

400.description: The new password is invalid or unchanged.

401.description: The session or current password is invalid.

403.description: CSRF proof is insufficient.

409.description: The password changed concurrently; retry with the latest password.

401.description: The session is missing, expired, revoked, or malformed.

delete.description: Revoke the current browser session, record an audit event, and expire both session cookies.

204.description: The current session was revoked and its cookies were expired.

401.description: The session is missing, expired, revoked, or malformed.

403.description: The double-submit CSRF proof is missing or invalid.
Member-management permission is required.

get.description: List recent internal invitations. Invitation secrets are never returned by this endpoint.

403.description: Member-management permission is required.

post.description: Create an internal one-time invitation. No email is sent and the secret is returned once.

201.description: Invitation created; copy its one-time secret now.

400.description: Username, display name, role, or expiry is invalid.

403.description: Permission or CSRF proof is insufficient.

409.description: The username already belongs to a member or pending invitation.

delete.description: Cancel one pending internal invitation without deleting its audit history.

403.description: Permission or CSRF proof is insufficient.

409.description: The invitation is absent, tenant-hidden, expired, or no longer pending.

post.description: Preview one internal invitation before accepting or declining it. The token is sent in the request body so it is not written into request paths.

410.description: The invitation is invalid, expired, accepted, or declined.

post.description: Accept one internal invitation, create a local username/password member, and start a browser session.

200.description: Invitation accepted and browser session issued.

400.description: The local password is invalid.

409.description: The username is no longer available.

410.description: The invitation is invalid, expired, accepted, or declined.

post.description: Decline an internal invitation without creating an account.

410.description: The invitation is invalid, expired, accepted, or already declined.

post.description: Create a one-time internal password-reset link for a non-owner member. No email is sent and older pending links are cancelled.

400.description: The target or expiry is invalid.

403.description: Permission or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The member is absent or tenant-hidden.

409.description: The protected owner cannot use an internal reset link.

post.description: Preview a one-time internal password-reset token sent in the request body.

410.description: The reset is invalid, expired, cancelled, or consumed.

post.description: Set a new local password, revoke previous sessions, consume the reset token, and issue a fresh browser session.

200.description: Password reset completed and a new browser session issued.

400.description: The new password is invalid.

410.description: The reset is invalid, expired, cancelled, or consumed.

204.description: Role updated and existing member sessions revoked.

400.description: The role is invalid.

403.description: Permission or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The member does not exist in this tenant.

409.description: The current user or protected owner cannot be changed.

204.description: Membership removed and existing sessions revoked.

403.description: Permission or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The member does not exist in this tenant.

409.description: The current user or protected owner cannot be removed.

post.description: Durably accept an MKS-1 heartbeat and update current service state atomically.

400.description: The payload, time window, content type, or idempotency key is invalid.

401.description: The service credential is invalid, expired, or revoked.

409.description: The idempotency key was already used with a different payload.

post.description: Durably accept an MKS-1 operational event.

400.description: The payload, time window, content type, or idempotency key is invalid.

401.description: The service credential is invalid, expired, or revoked.

409.description: The idempotency key was already used with a different payload.

post.description: Durably accept an MKS-1 deployment event.

400.description: The payload, time window, content type, or idempotency key is invalid.

401.description: The service credential is invalid, expired, or revoked.

409.description: The idempotency key was already used with a different payload.

post.description: Durably accept one MKA-1 batch, deduplicate exact retries, and expose sequence gaps.

202.description: Every acknowledged record is durable. X-Meerkateer-Sequence-Gap is true when earlier sequences are absent.

200.description: The exact batch retry was already durable.

400.description: The batch is malformed, unsafe, stale, future-dated, or mismatched to its idempotency key.

401.description: The agent credential is invalid, expired, revoked, or scoped to another agent.

409.description: The batch ID changed payload or its sequence overlaps accepted data.

200.description: Up to 200 tenant projects in stable creation order.

400.description: The request is invalid.

403.description: The role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

409.description: The project slug already exists in this tenant.

200.description: Up to 500 project services in stable creation order.

404.description: The project does not exist in this tenant.

400.description: The request is invalid.

403.description: The role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The project does not exist in this tenant.

409.description: The service already exists in this project and environment.

get.description: List the machines assigned to this workspace.

200.description: Up to 500 workspace machines in stable assignment order.

404.description: The workspace does not exist in this company.

put.description: Idempotently assign an existing company machine to this workspace.

204.description: The machine is assigned to the workspace.

403.description: Owner/admin role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The workspace or machine does not exist in this company.

delete.description: Remove a machine from this workspace without revoking the machine identity.

204.description: The machine is no longer assigned to the workspace.

403.description: Owner/admin role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The workspace assignment does not exist.

post.description: Issue a one-time enrollment token that automatically assigns its machine to this workspace.

201.description: The workspace-scoped token secret is returned once.

400.description: Expiry is outside the allowed range.

403.description: Owner/admin role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The workspace does not exist in this company.

503.description: The database or credential generator is unavailable.

get.description: Return the newest bounded service heartbeat, operational-event, and deployment facts for incident visualization.

200.description: Newest timeline facts first, with only display-safe normalized fields.

400.description: The requested limit is outside the supported range.

404.description: The service does not exist in this workspace.

post.description: Run one bounded Minecraft Java status query from the Community control plane. This is a manual observation, not scheduled monitoring, a player ping, or a gameplay/login test. Cloud mode does not expose this endpoint until isolated probe egress exists.

200.description: The bounded probe outcome, including no response or an unreadable response.

400.description: The configured destination is unsafe for a public probe.

403.description: The session or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The game instance is not in this company or Cloud mode is active.

409.description: The game configuration is incomplete.

post.description: Run one bounded HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, DNS, or TLS-certificate diagnostic from the Community control plane. Every DNS answer must be public and the validated numeric answers are pinned for the connection. Redirects are never followed. This manual result is not scheduled monitoring and does not change service health.

200.description: The bounded diagnostic outcome, including resolution, timeout, status, and certificate information when applicable.

400.description: The request is invalid or its DNS answer set includes a non-public destination.

403.description: The session or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The service is not in this company or Cloud mode is active.

get.description: Read the single scheduled network monitor configured as this service's health source.

200.description: Scheduled probe configuration and latest consensus.

403.description: The role is insufficient.

404.description: No scheduled probe exists for this service.

put.description: Create or replace the service's scheduled monitor. A service cannot use an active SDK credential and a scheduled probe at the same time, preventing contradictory health sources.

200.description: Saved configuration. The scheduler leases it immediately when enabled.

400.description: The configuration is invalid or unbounded.

403.description: Operator role and CSRF proof are required.

404.description: The service is not in this company or Cloud mode is active.

409.description: The service already has an active SDK credential.

delete.description: Delete a recovered or never-failed scheduled monitor and its bounded observation history. An offline monitor must recover before deletion so an active incident cannot be hidden.

403.description: Operator role and CSRF proof are required.

404.description: No scheduled probe exists for this service.

409.description: The monitor is offline and must recover before deletion.

get.description: Read the newest 50 bounded observations for this service's scheduled probe.

403.description: The role is insufficient.

post.description: Issue a one-time tenant-scoped agent enrollment token valid for 5-60 minutes.

201.description: The token secret is returned once and must be transferred securely to one agent.

400.description: Expiry is outside the allowed range.

403.description: Owner/admin role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

503.description: The database or credential generator is unavailable.

post.description: Consume a one-time enrollment token and issue a 90-day credential scoped to this installation.

201.description: Agent enrolled; the agent credential is returned once.

400.description: The bounded enrollment request is invalid.

401.description: The token is malformed, expired, consumed, or invalid.

409.description: This installation is already enrolled in the tenant.

503.description: The database or credential generator is unavailable.

200.description: Up to 500 tenant agents in stable enrollment order.

get.description: Return a bounded read model built only from the agent's latest durable batch. Metrics from older batches are never mixed into the snapshot.

200.description: Latest host and watched-process snapshot, including explicit missing and stale evidence.

403.description: The session cannot read this tenant.

404.description: The agent does not exist in this tenant.

delete.description: Revoke an agent and all of its active credentials immediately.

403.description: Owner/admin role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The active agent does not exist in this tenant.

post.description: Issue a new 90-day credential. The authenticated credential remains usable for a five-minute overlap.

201.description: The replacement credential is returned once.

401.description: The credential is malformed, expired, revoked, mismatched, or invalid.

503.description: The database or credential generator is unavailable.

post.description: Issue a service key. Its secret is returned once and only its Argon2id hash is retained.

403.description: The role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The service does not exist in this tenant.

503.description: The database or credential generator is unavailable.

post.description: Rotate a key with a bounded overlap of at most one hour.

201.description: The replacement key and the previous key expiry.

400.description: The overlap exceeds one hour.

403.description: The role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The active credential does not exist in this tenant.

503.description: The database or credential generator is unavailable.

delete.description: Revoke an active service credential immediately.

403.description: The role or CSRF proof is insufficient.

404.description: The active credential does not exist in this tenant.

200.description: The process event loop is responsive.

503.description: At least one required dependency is unhealthy.
The process must not receive traffic.

IngestAccepted.description: The message and outbox work are durable.

IngestDuplicate.description: This service already durably accepted the idempotency key.

RateLimited.description: This peer exceeded the node-local authentication or ingestion budget.

host.description: Bare DNS name or IP address; no URL scheme, path, or credentials.
Bare public DNS name or IP address; no URL scheme, path, or credentials.

port.description: Required for TCP; otherwise defaults to the protocol port.

path.description: Optional HTTP path. Redirects are not followed.

expected_status.description: Optional exact HTTP/HTTPS status. The default accepts 2xx and 3xx.

installation_id.description: Random per-installation ID, not a hardware serial or user identifier.
